scripts.dev:fork: npm run dev:chain:fork && npm run dev:services:fork
scripts.dev:services:fork: concurrently -k -n "indexer,backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "docker compose -f docker-compose.fork.yml up --force-recreate indexer" "npm run dev -w @othelio/backend" "npm run dev -w @othelio/fe"
scripts.dev:indexer:rebuild: docker compose -f docker-compose.fork.yml build indexer && docker compose -f docker-compose.fork.yml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate indexer
scripts.dev:reset:fork: docker compose -f docker-compose.fork.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans && npm run dev:chain:fork
scripts.build: npm run build -w @othelio/shared && npm run build -w @othelio/fe && npm run build -w @othelio/backend
